arxiv-2109-13416.title: LBV phenomenon and binarity: The environment of HR Car Thanks: Based on observations made with ESO Telescopes at the La Silla Paranal Observatory under programme ID 0102.C-0589(A).
arxiv-2109-13416.creator: A. Mehner, S. Janssens, C. Agliozzo, W.-J. de Wit, H. M. J. Boffin, D. Baade, J. Bodensteiner, J. H. Groh, L. Mahy, F. P. A. Vogt
arxiv-2109-13416.description: Abstract Luminous blue variable stars (LBVs) are of great interest in massive-star evolution as they experience very high mass-loss episodes within short periods of time. HR Car is a famous member of this class in the Galaxy. It has a large circumstellar nebula and has also been confirmed as being in a binary system.

arxiv-2207-07162.title: Audio-guided Album Cover Art Generation with Genetic Algorithms
arxiv-2207-07162.description: Abstract Over 60,000 songs are released on Spotify every day, and the competition for the listener’s attention is immense. In that regard, the importance of captivating and inviting cover art cannot be underestimated, because it is deeply entangled with a song’s character and the artist’s identity, and remains one of the most important gateways to lead people to discover music.

arxiv-2211-06238.title: Multitask Learning for Improved Late Mechanical Activation Detection of Heart From Cine DENSE MRI
arxiv-2211-06238.creator: Jiarui Xing Shuo Wang Kenneth C. Bilchick Frederick H. Epstein Amit R. Patel Miaomiao Zhang
arxiv-2211-06238.description: Abstract The selection of an optimal pacing site, which is ideally scar-free and late activated, is critical to the response of cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT). Despite the success of current approaches formulating the detection of such late mechanical activation (LMA) regions as a problem of activation time regression, their accuracy remains unsatisfactory, particularly in cases where myocardial scar exists.

arxiv-2212-11637.title: Time and Space Measures for a Complete Graph Computation Model
arxiv-2212-11637.creator: Brian Courtehoute and Detlef Plump
arxiv-2212-11637.description: Abstract We present a computation model based on a subclass of GP 2 graph programs which can simulate any off-line Turing machine of space complexity O ⁡ ( s ⁡ ( n ) ​ log ⁡ s ​ ( n ) ) \mathrm{O}(s(n)\log s(n)) in space O ⁡ ( s ⁡ ( n ) ) \mathrm{O}(s(n)) .

arxiv-2301-04825.title: First-principles thermal equation of state of fcc iridium
arxiv-2301-04825.creator: Kai Luo, R. E. Cohen, Ruifeng Lu
arxiv-2301-04825.description: Abstract The thermal equation of states for fcc iridium (Ir) is obtained from first-principles molecular dynamics up to 3000 K and 540 GPa. The equation of state (EoS) is globally fitted to a simplified free energy model and various parameters are derived. The theoretical principal Hugoniot is compared with shockwave experiments, where discrepancy suggests formation of new Ir phases.

arxiv-2306-06378.title: A Deep Unrolling Model with Hybrid Optimization Structure for Hyperspectral Image Deconvolution
arxiv-2306-06378.creator: Alexandros Gkillas, Dimitris Ampeliotis, Kostas Berberidis
arxiv-2306-06378.description: Abstract In recent literature there are plenty of works that combine handcrafted and learnable regularizers to solve inverse imaging problems. While this hybrid approach has demonstrated promising results, the motivation for combining handcrafted and learnable regularizers remains largely underexplored and has not been thoroughly studied in the existing literature.

arxiv-2403-00727.title: Moduli of sheaves on fourfolds as derived Lagrangian intersections
arxiv-2403-00727.creator: Nachiketa Adhikari, Yun Shi
arxiv-2403-00727.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nachiketa Adhikari, Yun Shi. We show that any ( − 2 ) (-2) -shifted symplectic derived scheme X (of finite type over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero) is locally equivalent to the derived intersection of two Lagrangian morphisms to a ( − 1 ) (-1) -shifted symplectic derived scheme which is the ( − 1 ) (-1) -shifted cotangent stack of a smooth classical scheme.

arxiv-2407-16218.title: Nano-optics of transition metal dichalcogenides and their van der Waals heterostructures with electron spectroscopies
arxiv-2407-16218.creator: Steffi Y. Woo, Luiz H. G. Tizei
arxiv-2407-16218.description: Abstract Abstract: The outstanding properties of transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers and their van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures, arising from their structure and the modified electron-hole Coulomb interaction in two-dimension, make them promising candidates for potential electro-optical devices. However, the production of reproducible devices remains challenging, partly due to variability at the nanometer to atomic scales.

arxiv-2409-02183.title: Thermodynamic properties of the macroscopically degenerate tetramer-dimer phase of the spin-1/2 Heisenberg model on the diamond-decorated square lattice
arxiv-2409-02183.creator: Katarína Karl’ová, Andreas Honecker, Nils Caci, Stefan Wessel, Jozef Strečka, Taras Verkholyak
arxiv-2409-02183.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Katarína Karl’ová, Andreas Honecker, Nils Caci, Stefan Wessel, Jozef Strečka, Taras Verkholyak. The spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the diamond-decorated square lattice in the presence of a magnetic field displays various quantum phases including the Lieb-Mattis ferrimagnetic, dimer-tetramer, monomer-dimer, and spin-canted phases, in addition to the trivial fully saturated state.

arxiv-2501-11281.title: Acyclic Edge Coloring of 3-sparse Graphs
arxiv-2501-11281.creator: Nevil Anto, Manu Basavaraju, Shashanka Kulamarva
arxiv-2501-11281.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nevil Anto, Manu Basavaraju, Shashanka Kulamarva. A proper edge coloring of a graph without any bichromatic cycles is said to be an acyclic edge coloring of the graph. The acyclic chromatic index of a graph G G denoted by a ′ ​ ( G ) a^{\prime}(G) , is the minimum integer k k such that G G has an acyclic edge coloring with k k colors.

arxiv-2601-16878.title: A Lyapunov-Tamed Euler Method for Singular SDEs
arxiv-2601-16878.creator: Tim Johnston, Pierre Monmarché
arxiv-2601-16878.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Tim Johnston, Pierre Monmarché. Many applications, such as systems of interacting particles in physics, require the simulation of diffusion processes with singular coefficients. Standard Euler schemes are then not convergent, and theoretical guarantees in this situation are scarce. In this work we introduce a Lyapunov-tamed Euler scheme, for drift coefficients for which the weak derivative is dominated by a function that obeys a certain generic Lyapunov-type condition. This allows for a range of coefficients that explode to infinity on a bounded set.

britannica-1911-portland-william-bentinc.title: Portland, William Bentinck, Earl of (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-portland-william-bentinc.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-portland-william-bentinc.description: Article 'Portland, William Bentinck, Earl of' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 22), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. English statesman, was born, according to the Dutch historian, Groen van Prinsterer, in 1645, although most of the other authorities give the date as 1649. The son of Henry Bentinck of Diepenheim, he was descended from an ancient and noble family of Gelderland. He became page of honour and then gentleman of the bedchamber to William, prince of Orange.

pmc-11182131.title: Evaluation of a steroid delivery system to mitigate the severity of proliferative vitreoretinopathy in a minipig model
pmc-11182131.creator: Chee Wai Wong, Ning Cheung, James S. Howden, Joanna Marie Fianza Busoy, Shaun Sim, Joshua Lim, Candice Ho, Amutha Barathi Veluchamy, Gert Storm, Tina T. Wong
pmc-11182131.description: PurposeTo investigate the efficacy of liposomal prednisolone phosphate to mitigate the severity of proliferative vitreoretinopathy (PVR) in a minipig model of PVR.MethodsA total of 18 eyes of 9 minipigs underwent PVR induction surgically. Eyes were randomized equally into three groups: intravitreal injection of liposomal prednisolone phosphate (LPP), triamcinolone acetonide (TA), and controls.

pmc-11308845.title: Evaluating Procedural Performance: A Composite Outcome for Aortic and Pulmonary Valvuloplasty in Congenital Cardiac Catheterization
pmc-11308845.creator: Babar S Hasan, Oliver M Barry, Fatima Ali, Aimee K Armstrong, Sarosh P Batlivala, Matthew A Crystal, Abhay Divekar, Todd Gudausky, Ralf Holzer, Jacqueline Kreutzer, George Nicholson, Michael L O’Byrne, Brian P Quinn, Brian A Boe
pmc-11308845.description: BackgroundSafety events and technical success (TS) have been previously reported for aortic and pulmonary valvuloplasty, but a composite performance measure as a novel, patient-centered strategy has neither been developed nor been studied. This study aims to refine a procedural performance (PP) variable, a composite of TS and procedural safety, for isolated, standard-risk aortic and pulmonary valvuloplasty.

pmc-11358963.title: Localization of β-Nerve Growth Factor in the Stallion Reproductive Tract
pmc-11358963.creator: Alison Mickelson, Forgivemore Magunda, James Graham, Patrick McCue
pmc-11358963.description: Simple SummaryThe goal of this research was to determine if the neurotrophin β-Nerve growth factor is present in the reproductive tract of stallions. This protein has been identified in the semen of camelids and functions to stimulate the release of a hormone from the pituitary of female camelids that is ultimately responsible for the induction of ovulation.

pmc-11494139.title: Prognostic value of pre-treatment neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio in patients with brain metastasis from cancer: a meta-analysis
pmc-11494139.creator: Ke Zhou, Jun Wan, Yile Li, Yi Yuan, Qian Liu, Huixuan Li, Xinyi Jiang, Xiang Yuan, Sen Zhang, Yu Zhang
pmc-11494139.description: Evidence shows that inflammatory responses play an essential role in the development of brain metastases (BM). The goal of this meta-analysis was to critically evaluate the literature regarding the use of the neutrophil to lymphocyte ratio (NLR) to predict the prognosis of patients with BM to help clinicians institute early interventions and improve outcomes.

pmc-11593586.title: A 3D Bioprinting Approach to Studying Retinal Müller Cells
pmc-11593586.creator: Davide Vecchiotti, Mauro Di Vito Nolfi, Francesca Veglianti, Francesca Dall’Aglio, Hafiz Nadeem Khan, Irene Flati, Daniela Verzella, Daria Capece, Edoardo Alesse, Adriano Angelucci, Francesca Zazzeroni, Julio Escribano
pmc-11593586.description: Background/Objectives: Bioprinting is an innovative technology in tissue engineering, enabling the creation of complex biological structures. This study aims to develop a three-dimensional (3D) bioprinted model of Müller cells (MCs) to enhance our understanding of their physiological and pathological roles in the retina.

pmc-13103927.title: Parallel Sequencing of the Two Arms on a Bispecific Antibody by Electron Capture Dissociation on a timsOmni Platform Reveals Several By-products in the Controlled Fab-arm Exchange Process
pmc-13103927.creator: Iuliia Stroganova, Simon Ollivier, Laura Radić, Athanasios Smyrnakis, Mariangela Kosmopoulou, Janke Schinkel, Kwinten Sliepen, Jean-François Greisch, Albert J.R. Heck
pmc-13103927.description: Bispecific antibodies (bsAbs) can simultaneously target two distinct antigens, offering enhanced therapeutic efficacy compared to conventional antibodies. However, their complex manufacturing process, involving pairing of four distinct polypeptide chains (two heavy and two light chains), enhances the analytical challenges in quality control.

pmc-13143497.title: Five Tips for Learning Plastic Surgery in the Artificial Intelligence Era
pmc-13143497.creator: Yair Shachar
pmc-13143497.description: ge language models can now provide tailored explanations, organize complex data, and simulate problem-solving scenarios. Despite these capabilities, many trainees still rely primarily on traditional methods such as textbooks and lengthy journal articles. Integrating AI into the learning process can enhance comprehension, efficiency, and long-term retention.

pmc-13269588.title: Affective Forecasting Accuracy in Everyday Life
pmc-13269588.creator: Ella K. Moeck, Komal K. Grewal, Ashish Mehta, Katharine H. Greenaway, Peter Koval, Elise K. Kalokerinos
pmc-13269588.description: People often predict how they might feel in the future, with varying degrees of accuracy. Such affective forecasts can centre around periods of time (e.g., tomorrow, next week) and/or specific events (e.g., an upcoming meeting). Affective forecasts for everyday events or periods of time are the building blocks of everyday decision-making.

pmc-13542807.title: Digital Mindfulness Intervention for Pregnant Women With Affective Disorders and Acute Stress Reactions: Prespecified Secondary Analysis of a Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13542807.creator: Kathrin Haßdenteufel, Mitho Müller, Jan Multmeier, Harald Abele, Sara Yvonne Brucker, Stefan Zipfel, Johanna Graf, Armin Bauer, Peter Jakubowski, Jan Pauluschke-Fröhlich, Markus Wallwiener, Stephanie Wallwiener
pmc-13542807.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPregnant women with ICD-10 (International Statistical Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision) affective or stress-related disorders face an elevated risk of perinatal depression and anxiety, yet evidence on digital nonpharmacologic interventions for this population remains limited.ObjectiveThis study evaluated the effectiveness of an 8-week digital mindfulness–based intervention (eMBI) compared with treatment as usual (TAU) among pregnant women with ICD-10 affective or stress-related disorders participating in a randomized controlled trial (RCT).MethodsThis prespecified secondary analysis was conducted within a multicenter RCT in Baden-Württemberg, Germany.

pmc-13559560.title: Predictive value of HALP score for clinical outcomes in lung cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13559560.creator: Yifan Wang, Jingguo Hu, Yu Sun, Kaixin Zhang
pmc-13559560.description: BackgroundThe hemoglobin-albumin-lymphocyte-platelet (HALP) index has emerged as a composite indicator reflecting nutritional and inflammatory status. Its prognostic relevance in lung cancer remains inconsistent across studies. This study quantitatively evaluated the association between pretreatment HALP levels and clinical outcomes in lung cancer.MethodsSeveral electronic databases were searched up to April 7, 2025. Primary endpoints included overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS).

pmc-13580478.title: Comment on “soluble cytokine receptor levels in obstructive sleep apnea patients treated with continuous positive airway pressure therapy”
pmc-13580478.creator: Duyu Nunya, Kanika Bhatia
pmc-13580478.description: kine receptor dynamics in patients with Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA) undergoing Continuous Positive Airway Pressure (CPAP) therapy, an area with growing translational relevance. Their use of soluble Cytokine receptors profiling rather than conventional circulating cytokine assessment represents an innovative methodological approach that may provide greater biological stability and insight into inflammatory signaling in OSA.
